name: ReachLearn
shortDescription: SMS, USSD and IVR microlearning gateway with real consent and delivery workflows.
features: Correct SMS segmentation and USSD menu limits
Learner state machine with STOP-wins opt-out
Consent, quiet hours and frequency caps per subscription
Idempotent provider callbacks with delivery states
Labelled local simulator — never presented as real delivery
knownLimitations: Simulator only in the demo (provider adapter ready for configuration)
Job scheduling uses explicit local_hour in this MVP
